issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates literal delimiter characters with OpenAPI symbolic style names in one dict.
issues.detail: Mixing identity entries like ',' -> ',' with alias entries like 'pipeDelimited' -> '|' obscures the data structure and risks future collisions. A small set of allowed chars plus a tiny alias map ({'pipeDelimited': '|', 'spaceDelimited': ' '}) would make resolution self-evident and keep validation honest.

issues.description: delimiter argument silently no-ops when the value already arrived as a list from multiple param instances.
issues.detail: When the same param appears multiple times, items is already a list and the delimiter branch is bypassed. A caller passing delimiter expects splitting and gets something else. Either also split each element, or make the no-op explicit and verify transform still applies uniformly to the result.

issues.description: ValueError raised on unsupported delimiter is not declared in the Raises section of the docstring.
issues.detail: The new precondition is enforced by raising ValueError, but the Raises clause only documents HTTPBadRequest. Callers reading the spec cannot know unsupported delimiters throw, and the surrounding except-ValueError block around transform may interact unexpectedly. Document explicitly and confirm the programmer error is not silently swallowed.

issues.description: Stringly-typed delimiter API would be clearer as an enum or typed literal union.
issues.detail: delimiter='pipeDelimited' is a magic string validated only at runtime. A small Enum or Literal union would let the type checker do the work and clarify the contract between symbolic names and literal chars. Not load-bearing, but reduces framework feel.

issues.description: Blank/empty-token behavior after split is undefined and untested.
issues.detail: What does get_param_as_list('x', delimiter=',') return for 'x=a,,b'? The docstring notes keep_blank_qs_values has no effect on secondary splitting, but no test pins the actual behavior. Add one test so the next maintainer doesn't have to guess.

issues.description: Missing tests for delimiter default path and delimiter combined with missing param or transform.
issues.detail: The opt-in nature of delimiter isn't pinned: no test covers default delimiter=None preserving existing behavior on a comma-containing value, the missing-param branch with delimiter set, or delimiter combined with transform. Cheap regression insurance to lock the contract.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small, well-scoped patch with clear data flow and reasonable test coverage of happy paths. The dominant concern, flagged by all three reviewers, is that _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates literal delimiter characters with OpenAPI symbolic style names in a single dict, obscuring the algorithm; splitting into a set of allowed chars plus a tiny alias map is the recommended fix. Secondary concerns: the delimiter argument silently no-ops on already-list values, the ValueError contract is undocumented, and several edge-case tests (blank tokens, default path, transform interaction) are missing. Lands after these are addressed.
